title: Listening Drill — Indoor seedlings
description: Short academic talk. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Indoor seedlings
sections.transcript:
PRESENTER: Today I'm describing a small study of how seedlings respond to different lamps. I want you to listen for how the researchers measured change, because the result is easy to overstate.

PRESENTER: Their work took place in a single room at a training college. Instead of relying on what local people remembered, they recorded leaf number. They noticed uneven growth. That observation would have been missed if the team had visited only at the end.

PRESENTER: The largest limitation was lamp position. The report is therefore a starting point. In a follow-up, the team would add rotating trays. A wider study could show whether the original pattern holds.
